title: Altitude Gain Progression
description: A hiker records their elevation at various checkpoints along a mountain trail. Find the length of the longest strictly increasing subsequence of elevation checkpoints.
input_format: An integer array nums representing elevation checkpoints.
output_format: An integer representing the length of the longest strictly increasing subsequence.

examples.explanation: The longest increasing subsequence is [2, 3, 7, 101], therefore the length is 4.
The longest increasing subsequence is [0, 1, 2, 3], therefore the length is 4.
All elements are equal, so the longest strictly increasing subsequence has length 1.
